## Summary

What engineering decision, risk, or reader need does this change address?

## Change type

- [ ] Correction or clarification
- [ ] New guidance or template
- [ ] Navigation or project maintenance
- [ ] Security-sensitive guidance (no undisclosed vulnerability details)

## Technical basis

Describe assumptions, trade-offs, and supporting evidence. Link the issue or ADR where applicable.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally.
- [ ] New and changed links resolve.
- [ ] Diagrams render in GitHub-flavored Markdown.
- [ ] Reader-visible changes are noted in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Examples contain no credentials, personal data, or proprietary material.

## Screenshots or rendered preview

Add only when layout or diagrams materially changed.
